body:
Deck list with win/loss/draw records, players/bots/min-games/player/card filters, sample-size-adjusted (Wilson) default sort, chips per deck with a big card tooltip on hover/tap/focus, expandable full-deck grid, Cards tab with per-card records, deep links, 30s refresh, phone layout. Backed by new public read-only IDUNA endpoints /api/v1/games/deadweight/{decks,decks/{id},card-stats} tailing dw_server decks.ndjson, and data/cards.json generated by DEADWEIGHT/scripts/export_cards.sh. Verified with headless Chrome against live data (desktop + phone width, hover tooltip on the live site). Not verified: touch tap-to-pin on a real device. Sign-in deliberately disabled (accounts later).

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN: DEADWEIGHT Draft Decks browser (unauthenticated) live at wotan.okemily.com/decks.html
